capabilities: Start, stop and switch Clockify timers from commands, notes or task lines
Show the running timer and today's total in a panel or the desktop status bar
Render report blocks grouped by project, day or description
Edit and delete past time entries from the timer panel
Queue timer starts and stops offline and send them when back online
disambiguation: Not a local Pomodoro or stopwatch timer; it remotely controls time tracking in the Clockify service through its API.
extras: Freemium: core timer control is free; reports, entry editing, project/tag pickers and the offline queue require a $5/month or $15 one-time GitHub Sponsors sponsorship. The README details privacy: note titles or task lines are sent to Clockify as timer descriptions, and a What's new tab promotes the author's other plugins and Zovo Chat (can be turned off).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to control a Clockify timer, and phones have no status bar to show a running timer.

relations.evidence: Mobile Timer for Clockify talks to Clockify through its public API
